mapper.sql: s.state_log_id, s.equip_id, e.equip_cd, e.equip_nm, e.plant_cd, s.state_cat, coalesce(nr.state_cat, s.state_cat) as eff_cat, lr.reason_cd as log_reason_cd, lr.reason_nm as log_reason_nm, n.note_id, nr.reason_cd as note_reason_cd, nr.reason_nm as note_reason_nm, nr.planned_yn as note_planned_yn, n.note_text, n.recorded_by as note_by, n.recorded_at as note_at, s.start_at, s.end_at, w.wo_no, s.source, d.link_id, m.mwo_id, m.mwo_no, m.status as mwo_status, m.down_start_at as mwo_down_start_at, m.down_end_at as mwo_down_end_at

from cms_equip_state_log s join mst_equip e on e.equip_id = s.equip_id left join cms_state_reason lr on lr.reason_id = s.reason_id left join prd_wo w on w.wo_id = s.wo_id left join cms_state_note n on n.state_log_id = s.state_log_id and n.void_yn = 'N' left join cms_state_reason nr on nr.reason_id = n.reason_id left join cms_mwo_down d on d.state_log_id = s.state_log_id and d.void_yn = 'N' left join cms_mwo m on m.mwo_id = d.mwo_id
mapper.select:
select
order by
e.equip_cd desc coalesce(nr.state_cat, s.state_cat) desc s.end_at desc nulls last m.mwo_no desc nulls last s.start_at desc ,
s.state_log_id desc limit #{page.size} offset #{page.offset}

select n.note_id, r.reason_cd, r.reason_nm, r.state_cat, n.note_text, n.recorded_at, n.recorded_by, n.void_yn, n.void_reason, n.voided_by, n.voided_at from cms_state_note n join cms_state_reason r on r.reason_id = n.reason_id where n.state_log_id = #{stateLogId} order by n.note_id desc

select d.link_id, m.mwo_id, m.mwo_no, m.title, m.status, m.down_start_at, m.down_end_at, d.recorded_at, d.recorded_by, d.void_yn, d.void_reason, d.voided_by, d.voided_at from cms_mwo_down d join cms_mwo m on m.mwo_id = d.mwo_id where d.state_log_id = #{stateLogId} order by d.link_id desc
insert into cms_state_note (comp_cd, state_log_id, reason_id, note_text, recorded_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{stateLogId}, #{reasonId}, #{noteText}, #{by}) returning note_id
mapper.update: update cms_state_note set void_yn = 'Y', void_reason = #{reason}, voided_by = #{by}, voided_at = now() where note_id = #{noteId} and state_log_id = #{stateLogId} and void_yn = 'N'
mapper.select: insert into cms_mwo_down (comp_cd, mwo_id, state_log_id, recorded_by) values (hb_current_comp(), #{mwoId}, #{stateLogId}, #{by}) returning link_id
mapper.update: update cms_mwo_down set void_yn = 'Y', void_reason = #{reason}, voided_by = #{by}, voided_at = now() where link_id = #{linkId} and state_log_id = #{stateLogId} and void_yn = 'N'
mapper.select: select s.state_log_id, s.state_cat, coalesce(nr.state_cat, s.state_cat) as eff_cat, s.start_at, s.end_at, coalesce(nr.reason_cd, lr.reason_cd) as reason_cd, coalesce(nr.reason_nm, lr.reason_nm) as reason_nm from cms_mwo_down d join cms_equip_state_log s on s.state_log_id = d.state_log_id left join cms_state_reason lr on lr.reason_id = s.reason_id left join cms_state_note n on n.state_log_id = s.state_log_id and n.void_yn = 'N' left join cms_state_reason nr on nr.reason_id = n.reason_id where d.mwo_id = #{mwoId} and d.void_yn = 'N' order by s.start_at
select l.alarm_id, l.alarm_cd, l.alarm_text, l.raised_at, l.cleared_at from cms_alarm_log l where l.mwo_id = #{mwoId} order by l.raised_at
